out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Described disconnecting from pain and becoming peaceful; hesitated to return while brother still held him under water.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Later reports awareness of conversations with Jesus (Yeshua) and Lucifer (Satan); primary encountered throne-being interpreted as God / Elohim (Trinity presenting as one).
arrival.other_being_detail: Reports many souls in a courtyard-like area; a 'Council of Beings' reviewing 'sealed records'; souls sorted into groups; also mentions bound/isolated beings.

environment.environment_other_detail: Veiled private 'God’s Chambers' / throne area; ornate throne of gold and ivory; white robe with golden belt; bronze hands/feet; pearl-white crown/face-covering energy; translucent rainbow aura with sparkling color shifts; holographic presentations; courtyard-like area with many souls.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Return described as part of a prior agreement/contract with tasks to complete; strong reluctance/objections initially.
boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: From above father’s left shoulder (3–4 feet away), then 'took in a deep breath, in spiritual form' and began coughing up water in body.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Told he was going back to guide family through a future event; also framed as resolving mother’s guilt/remorse and understanding purpose in her life.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Drowning during a 'game' in a stream; brother held him under water.

person_demographics.religious_background_detail: Raised by 'hard core Southern Baptist' parents ('Hell, Fire and Brimstone').
person_demographics.religious_belief_at_nde_detail: States he 'almost considered' himself agnostic; accepted presence of Jesus (Yeshua) early but rejected parents’ specific beliefs.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Holographic presentations of cosmic history/creation; councils reviewing records; sorting of souls; reincarnation/training centers; explicit statement of bypassing 'tunnel of lights', meeting pets/family, 'angels or elders helping me across' (in his case).
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE during drowning → 'home' sense → immediate presence before throne-entity in veiled chamber (no tunnel) → holographic/cosmic revelations and multi-life review → decision/agreement to return → returns near father during CPR and re-enters body coughing water.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Explicitly frames experience as 'God’s Chambers' with an ornate throne-being and 'holographic presentations'; describes an 'atypical review' spanning three lifetimes and reincarnation contract with mother; reports bypassing typical tunnel/loved-ones/pets elements; describes prior/other OBEs and later visitations (including demonic attacks and councils of angels).
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was ‘Here,’ I was ‘home again,’ I made it back … I was finally free…”; “standing in a veiled area, in front of a benevolent Entity… sitting on a very ornate thrown of Gold and Ivory.”; Mother during CPR: “No, I was just told he is returning now.”
